# `foxglove config set`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](config.md)

```text
Set a configuration value

Usage: foxglove config set [OPTIONS] <KEY> <VALUE>

Arguments:
  <KEY>
          [possible values: project-id]

  <VALUE>
          Value to save. Whitespace is trimmed and the value cannot be empty

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
